authorization: Owner approved bounded adoption cleanup for the writing-plans personal skill.

backup.integrity: All three original file hashes were recomputed from the archive.

changes.summary: Replaced blanket before-code planning trigger and 268-line process with a concise standalone-plan/handoff trigger, proportional guidance, product-workflow routing, preserved user authority, and no routine review/approval/execution-method gate. Independent review is allowed when requested by the user or required by a governing workflow.
Added progressive-disclosure guidance for substantial standalone plans: useful outline, meaningful task boundaries, concrete verification, and self-review.

Moved the existing reusable reviewer prompt under references and added an explicit opt-in gate; retained its review format for requested independent reviews. Reviewer inputs now accept a formal spec or current request/accepted requirements and permit explicitly bounded unresolved decisions.
Preserved display_name; clarified short_description. No invocation policy or dependency field was added, so implicit invocation remains available.

routing_review.references_found: Repository-wide search of personal skill roots found the old reviewer prompt referenced only by this skill; metadata was confined to agents/openai.yaml. No other callers required edits.

examples.request: Create a separate task-by-task implementation plan from accepted requirements.
examples.route: Use writing-plans; save in requested or repository-conventional location.

examples.request: Fix a selected, actionable issue under an existing accepted product task.
examples.route: Skip generic writing-plans; use the product-task workflow and proceed with authorized implementation.

examples.request: Plan a multi-step change with unresolved interfaces or sequencing.
examples.route: Use writing-plans only if a written plan is materially needed; keep assumptions/open decisions explicit and continue other authorized work.

examples.request: A governing workflow requires plan review even though the user did not ask separately.
examples.route: Use the optional reviewer prompt when a suitable reviewer is available; assess the current request and accepted requirements, and distinguish bounded decisions from blockers.

routing_review.dependency_cleanup: Removed mandatory references to unavailable superpowers worktree/planning/subagent-execution skills and automatic persistent reviewer/handoff gates. Retained an opt-in independent-review prompt only.

validation.yaml_runtime_note: System and bundled Python lacked PyYAML. Ran the validator unchanged with its yaml.safe_load interface supplied by Ruby Psych via an in-memory adapter; separately parsed agents/openai.yaml with Ruby Psych and checked preserved interface metadata.
manual_checks: Frontmatter allows name, description, metadata and stays within validator constraints.
No superpowers or REQUIRED SUB-SKILL dependencies remain.
Reference links resolve inside the skill directory.
Implicit invocation remains enabled because no explicit-only policy was introduced.
validation.forward_routing: Reviewed the three representative request routes above without spawning agents or using a provider.
validation.quick_validate_after_correction: Passed: Skill is valid! (same in-memory Ruby Psych adapter; system/bundled Python still lacks PyYAML)
reviewer_template_checks: A formal spec is optional when current request and accepted requirements state governing intent.
Bounded unresolved decisions are recorded with ownership or gates and only block when safe ordering or acceptance is impossible.

limitations: No live skill-selection telemetry was available; routing was assessed from the description, instructions, metadata, and representative requests.
The validator required the in-memory Ruby Psych adapter because PyYAML was unavailable; its normal Python invocation could not import yaml.

review_correction.reason: Consistency review found the skill entrypoint was narrower than its optional review prompt and the prompt required an approved specification and zero unresolved decisions for every review.
review_correction.correction: Aligned the trigger to user request OR governing workflow requirement; reviewer accepts the current request/accepted requirements as its source and treats explicit, bounded, owned or gated decisions as nonblocking unless they prevent safe sequencing or testable acceptance.
review_correction.review_criteria: Specification coverage, scope, ordering, interfaces, paths, verification, constraints, and executable detail remain required.
